scope: small-crate diagnostic tooling and semantic qualification only
resource_sampling_caveat: 100ms sampling can miss short processes/peaks; zero samples are not zero actual memory. Each nested command has its own resource receipt; the outer orchestration row is not an aggregate nested peak.
full_workload_blocker: Current full 90-module source-to-checked qualification timed out at the existing 600-second limit before publishing a checked artifact. No complete-workload backend measurements or speedup claim are available.

ordinary.ll.reason: Exact local output retained with the complete run; avoid committing an unnecessary generated LLVM listing.

raw_receipt_policy: Original raw receipts remain local and are not durably persisted by this public checkpoint. SHA-256 identities cannot restore their contents. If local evidence is unavailable, rerun smoke.py and preserve a new qualification with its own identities.
